summary: The packet has a strong core of primary-source and high-signal items: Anthropic's confidential S-1 filing, Claude Code rate-limit reset, OpenAI models on AWS, NVIDIA local-AI hardware, and Altman's correction on AI job-performance claims. However, the set is too Anthropic/Claude-heavy, includes several low-engagement practice or learning posts, and relies on secondary/commentary tweets for some factual claims. Replace weaker evergreen/practice items with eligible reserve items or run additional Twitter/X searches for stronger sources.
